introHtml: Custom 21 oz wine glasses offer a generous capacity that sets them apart from standard 12–15 oz options, making them ideal for promotional events, corporate gifts, or hospitality settings where guests appreciate a fuller pour. These larger glasses provide ample space for branding with screen printing or etching, ensuring your logo stands out. Whether you're planning a trade show giveaway or outfitting a company event, 21 oz wine glasses combine practicality with a premium feel that recipients will use again and again.
